name: Heatran
description: Stories tell of this Pokémon being birthed from the boiling magma within Mount Coronet. Its molten-steel body holds many mysteries.

moves.name: Ember
moves.description: The target is attacked with small flames. This may also leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Iron Defense
moves.description: The user hardens its body's surface like iron, raising its defensive stats.

moves.name: Ancient Power
moves.description: The user attacks with a primeval power. This may also raise the user's offensive and defensive stats.

moves.name: Fire Fang
moves.description: The user bites the target with flame-cloaked fangs to deal damage. This may also leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Iron Head
moves.description: The user slams the target with its steel-hard head.

moves.name: Crunch
moves.description: The user crunches up the target with sharp fangs. This may also lower the target's defensive stats.

moves.name: Earth Power
moves.description: The user makes the ground under the target erupt with power. This may also lower the target's defensive stats.

moves.name: Magma Storm
moves.description: The user envelops the target in a maelstrom of fire. This also leaves the target with a burn.
